theorem lg_target (p : NNReal) (h : p ≤ 1) : ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure p true = (p : ENNReal) := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure_def, ENNReal.coe_inj_iff]
  constructor
  · intro p h'
    rw [ENNReal.coe_le_iff _ _]
    exact ⟨p, h'⟩
  · intro p
    rw [ENNReal.coe_lt_one_iff, h]
    exact lt_irrefl p
